_about: The pdf-to-template flow (flow.json 1.3.0) as a project graph on the flow and report vocabularies: what tools/kgctl.py builds from flow.json, bindings.ttl and derive_tests.rq. Rebuilt by tools/flow_port.py; never edited by hand.

nodes.label: PDF sample → frozen report template → monthly rendering
nodes.summary: Executable process graph. BUILD phase turns one sample PDF into a verified, human-approved, versioned template project (HTML/CSS/Jinja2 + data schema). RUN phase renders new data through a frozen template, verifies every document, and publishes after human compliance review. Deterministic scripts own every routing decision; Claude, OCR and humans each do one bounded job inside nodes and their output is always checked by deterministic validations before the flow moves on.

nodes.label: Intake source PDF
nodes.summary: Opens the sample PDF, records its fingerprint and basic geometry, and creates the run folder. Everything later is traceable to this hash.

nodes.label: opens
nodes.summary: PDF opens and is not encrypted

nodes.label: Inspect & classify pages
nodes.summary: Classifies each page as vector (real text and drawings), raster (a picture of a page) or mixed, and extracts everything measurable: spans with font/size/color/bbox, drawings, embedded fonts, large images, and a 300-dpi image of each page.

nodes.label: OCR raster content
nodes.summary: Runs OCR on raster and mixed pages (only on image areas) and writes words in the same schema as vector spans, with a confidence per word and an estimated point size from glyph height. Words below the confidence threshold are listed with image crops for a human to correct.

nodes.label: pass
nodes.summary: All text read with high confidence.

nodes.label: low_confidence
nodes.summary: Some words need a human check.

nodes.label: words_found
nodes.summary: OCR found text on every raster page

nodes.label: Human: correct text
nodes.summary: A person corrects text the machine is unsure of: low-confidence OCR words (from B02) or data slots that could not be filled or parsed (from B07). Each item shows the image crop and the proposed value.

nodes.label: incomplete
nodes.summary: Some items still open; stays with the human.

nodes.label: all_items_resolved
nodes.summary: Every listed item has a corrected value

nodes.label: Detect regions & measure tokens
nodes.summary: Finds the page's boxes and assigns every piece of text to one. Vector pages: boxes from stroked rectangles in drawings.json. Raster pages: horizontal/vertical rule detection with OpenCV. Then measures design tokens: palette per role (title, rules, fills, chart marks), type scale, rule widths, margins and column x-positions.

nodes.label: fail
nodes.summary: Layout detection unreliable; needs a human decision.

nodes.label: regions_found
nodes.summary: At least one region per page

nodes.label: text_assigned
nodes.summary: Almost all text sits inside a region

nodes.label: Claude: build blueprint
nodes.summary: Claude looks at the page image with numbered regions and the text list, and decides what each region IS: which component type it is (reusing the library where possible), which text is static label versus a named data slot, the slot's type, and what repeats (rows, groups, chart series). This is the step no script can do: it turns geometry into meaning.

nodes.label: invalid_output
nodes.summary: Output failed checks after all retries.

nodes.label: library_gap
nodes.summary: The page needs a component the library does not have. Add it to the library (its own release), then resume.

nodes.label: spans_covered
nodes.summary: Every span is static or a slot, never both, never neither

nodes.label: no_new_components
nodes.summary: Every component the blueprint uses exists in the shared library; a report needing a new component stops here so the component is added to the library by its own release

nodes.label: Human: approve blueprint
nodes.summary: The cheapest place for human judgment. A person checks the labeled overlay: are the boxes right, are the slot names the ones the data team uses, is anything static that should be data (or the reverse)? Renaming a slot here costs seconds; after template generation it costs a repair loop.

nodes.label: invalid_edit
nodes.summary: Human edit broke the schema; stays with the human.

nodes.label: still_valid
nodes.summary: If the human edited blueprint.json, it still matches the schema

nodes.label: Derive data schema & sample data
nodes.summary: Code, not an LLM, produces the data contract and the source's own data. The data schema comes from blueprint slots (types, required, arrays for repeats, observed max lengths). Sample values are copied from the text via each slot's source_span_ids and parsed by type and locale (percent, currency, date). Anything unparseable goes to a human.

nodes.label: pass
nodes.summary: Data contract and sample data ready.

nodes.label: Claude: generate template project
nodes.summary: Claude writes the template code from the approved blueprint: tokens.css from measured tokens, one Jinja macro per component (reusing the library), the page shell, layouts, i18n labels and chart configuration. It writes no Python: formatting and chart rendering are plugin filters driven by config/charts.json. It does not see thresholds and cannot change the data or the schema.

nodes.label: pass
nodes.summary: Template project compiles and covers the data.

nodes.label: invalid_output
nodes.summary: Output failed checks after all retries.

nodes.label: files_present
nodes.summary: tokens.css, components.j2, base.html.j2, layouts.json, i18n.json exist

nodes.label: no_project_code
nodes.summary: The template project contains no code files (.py/.js/.sh); formatting and charts come from the plugin's filters, configured in config/charts.json

nodes.label: compiles
nodes.summary: All Jinja templates compile; filters.py imports

nodes.label: dry_render
nodes.summary: Renders sample_data with StrictUndefined (no missing fields)

nodes.label: slot_coverage
nodes.summary: Every data_schema field is used by a template

nodes.label: no_hardcoding
nodes.summary: No sample data value is pasted literally into a template

nodes.label: writes_scoped
nodes.summary: Only templates/ and config/ were written

nodes.label: Render sample
nodes.summary: Renders the source's own data through the template with headless Chromium. Same data as the source means any visual difference is a template defect.

nodes.label: fail
nodes.summary: Render crashed or wrong page count.

nodes.label: page_count
nodes.summary: Same page count as the source

nodes.label: Verify render vs source
nodes.summary: Five checks, per region (regions come from the blueprint, so a failure names the component to fix): overflow (content larger than its box), data fidelity (every slot value is in the PDF text layer inside its region), visibility (OCR of the rendered image finds the value, which catches text clipped by CSS but still in the text layer), visual similarity (SSIM per region against the source) and style (font size and color against tokens).

nodes.label: pass
nodes.summary: Render matches the source on every blocking check.

nodes.label: fail
nodes.summary: At least one region fails; verify.json lists which and why.

nodes.label: overflow
nodes.summary: No box overflows or runs off the page

nodes.label: fidelity
nodes.summary: Every slot value present in its region (PDF text layer)

nodes.label: visibility
nodes.summary: Every slot value visible on the rendered image (OCR)

nodes.label: similarity
nodes.summary: Each region's SSIM above threshold (vector sources); advisory for raster sources

nodes.label: style
nodes.summary: Font sizes within tolerance, colors within ΔE

nodes.label: Claude: repair failing components
nodes.summary: Claude receives only the failures (verify.json, stress_report.json, or human comments, depending on state.context.repair_context) with source|render crops of each failing region, and edits only the components those regions map to. Each round is logged. It cannot touch data, schema, config or thresholds.

nodes.label: invalid_output
nodes.summary: Repair broke scope or compilation after retries.

nodes.label: scoped
nodes.summary: Only allowed files changed; data, schema and thresholds untouched

nodes.label: Human: escalation triage
nodes.summary: Generic stop for anything automation could not resolve (layout detection failed, Claude output invalid after retries, repair rounds exhausted). The page shows the node that escalated, its validation history and artifacts. The human either retries (optionally with guidance that is passed to the next Claude call), proceeds with a recorded waiver, or abandons.

nodes.label: Generate stress data
nodes.summary: Generates edge-case documents from the data schema with a fixed seed, so every run produces the same cases: longest strings, most rows, fewest rows, missing optional fields, numeric extremes (negatives, 3-digit percents) and French labels/number formats.

nodes.label: deterministic
nodes.summary: Generating twice with the same schema and seed gives byte-identical files

nodes.label: Render & verify stress cases
nodes.summary: Renders every stress case and runs overflow, fidelity and visibility checks (no similarity check: the data is different by design). This is what proves the template works for next month's data, not just this month's.

nodes.label: fail
nodes.summary: Some cases break; stress_report lists them.

nodes.label: all_pass
nodes.summary: Every stress case passes overflow, fidelity, visibility

nodes.label: Human: visual sign-off
nodes.summary: Final human approval. The page shows source | render side by side, every stress case, all metrics, and any waivers granted in B12. The approval records the sha256 of the template files reviewed, so B16 can prove nothing changed after sign-off.

nodes.label: request_changes
nodes.summary: Back to repair with human comments.

nodes.label: Freeze & version
nodes.summary: Copies the template project to the release folder under a new version, writes a manifest of file hashes, saves golden renders and a mask of static regions (regions with no slots) for production checks, and publishes the data schema for the data team. Records the engine version. Requires fonts resolved and loaded, and a vector reference or a named waiver.

nodes.label: manifest
nodes.summary: Manifest hashes match the released files

nodes.label: unchanged_since_signoff
nodes.summary: Template hash equals the hash recorded in the B15 approval

nodes.label: fonts_resolved
nodes.summary: Every font family in tokens.css resolves to a file via @font-face

nodes.label: fonts_loaded
nodes.summary: Renderer reports every declared font loaded (document.fonts.check), no silent fallback

nodes.label: reference_kind
nodes.summary: Reference is vector, or a named waiver is recorded

nodes.label: semantic_valid
nodes.summary: semantic/*.yaml validate against their schemas (undeclared property = error) and are complete (every field defined, placed, with meaning and lineage entry)

nodes.label: semantic_compiles
nodes.summary: semantic layer + manifest compile to report.graph.json: every emitted predicate is declared in the report ontology, ontology versions agree

nodes.label: semantic_conforms
nodes.summary: report.graph.json passes report-shapes.ttl (Violation = a competency question cannot be answered; Warnings listed in the release notes)

nodes.label: manifest_schema
nodes.summary: manifest.json validates against manifest.schema.json; ontology_version compatible; template_id/version agree with the semantic layer

nodes.label: Template frozen
nodes.summary: A versioned, approved template is ready for production runs.

nodes.label: Abandoned
nodes.summary: A human stopped the build. state.approvals holds the reason.

nodes.label: Load batch data
nodes.summary: Checks the requested template release exists and is intact, then loads one data file per document from the warehouse (e.g. a BigQuery stored procedure per template) and creates one state item per document.

nodes.label: ontology_version
nodes.summary: Release manifest validates against the engine's manifest schema and was compiled against a compatible report ontology (same major.minor)

nodes.label: engine_version
nodes.summary: Running engine version equals the one pinned in the release manifest

nodes.label: all_loaded
nodes.summary: Every document has a data file

nodes.label: Validate data
nodes.summary: Each document's data must match the released data schema, plus business rules declared in it (e.g. allocation rows sum to 100% ± 0.5).

nodes.label: partial
nodes.summary: Some invalid; they wait for exceptions.

nodes.label: Render documents
nodes.summary: Renders each valid document with the frozen template.

nodes.label: Verify documents
nodes.summary: Per document: overflow, data fidelity, visibility (OCR), and static regions compared to the golden render (labels, logos, disclaimers must be pixel-stable month to month).

nodes.label: Human: triage exceptions
nodes.summary: A person decides what to do with failed documents: data fixed upstream (retry those items), exclude them from this batch, or declare a template defect (stops the batch; the failing data becomes a new stress case in a build run that starts at repair).

nodes.label: retry
nodes.summary: Re-run the listed items from validation.

nodes.label: Human: compliance sample
nodes.summary: A deterministic, risk-based sample is shown to compliance before anything is published: always every document retried in R04, every first-time fund/series/language combination and every document with a non-blocking warning; plus random max(compliance_sample_min, compliance_sample_rate x documents) for a release's first compliance_clean_batches_to_relax batches, then compliance_sample_rate_steady.

nodes.label: Publish
nodes.summary: Uploads every approved document to its destination and writes a receipt with hashes.

nodes.label: all_published
nodes.summary: Every approved document published with matching hash

nodes.label: Template defect
nodes.summary: The template cannot handle real data. Start a build run at B11_repair with the failing documents added as stress cases.

nodes.label: Publish failed
nodes.summary: Upload kept failing after retries. Documents are rendered and approved; re-run R06 once the destination is fixed.

nodes.label: source_pdf
nodes.summary: The sample report the template must look like.

nodes.label: intake_manifest
nodes.summary: Source hash, page count, page sizes, encryption flag.

nodes.label: inspect_report
nodes.summary: Per-page verdict (vector | raster | mixed), fonts, sizes, colors, large images.

nodes.label: page_images
nodes.summary: Each source page rasterized at config.inspect_dpi. The visual reference for every later comparison.

nodes.label: page_spans
nodes.summary: Vector text spans: text, bbox, font, size, color, bold, italic.

nodes.label: page_drawings
nodes.summary: Vector rules, boxes and fills with colors.

nodes.label: embedded_fonts
nodes.summary: Font files embedded in a vector source.

nodes.label: raster_images
nodes.summary: Large embedded images (a raster page's real content).

nodes.label: ocr_words
nodes.summary: OCR words in the same schema as vector spans, plus confidence.

nodes.label: ocr_low_conf
nodes.summary: Words below config.ocr_min_confidence, with image crops, for human correction.

nodes.label: text_corrections
nodes.summary: Human-corrected text keyed by word/span id or slot name.

nodes.label: unified_text
nodes.summary: One text list per page in a common schema: vector spans + OCR words with corrections applied, each with a stable span_id.

nodes.label: regions
nodes.summary: Detected boxes/regions with bbox, border/fill colors and the span_ids inside each.

nodes.label: regions_overlay
nodes.summary: Page image with numbered region boxes drawn on it. Input for Claude and for humans.

nodes.label: tokens_draft
nodes.summary: Measured design tokens: palette (per region role), type scale, rule widths, page margins, column x-positions.

nodes.label: component_library
nodes.summary: Existing components Claude should reuse before inventing new ones.

nodes.label: authoring_rules
nodes.summary: Rules for writing templates that survive real data.

nodes.label: blueprint
nodes.summary: The semantic model of the page: every region → component type; every text → static or a named data slot; what repeats.

nodes.label: blueprint_overlay
nodes.summary: Page image with each region labeled by component and slot names (drawn deterministically from blueprint.json).

nodes.label: data_schema
nodes.summary: JSON Schema for one document's data, derived from blueprint slots (types, required, arrays, observed max lengths).

nodes.label: sample_data
nodes.summary: The source PDF's own data, filled by code from the text via the blueprint slot map. Used to compare the render to the source.

nodes.label: data_gaps
nodes.summary: Slots that could not be filled or parsed, for human correction.

nodes.label: template_project
nodes.summary: templates/tokens.css, templates/components.j2, templates/base.html.j2, config/layouts.json, config/i18n.json, config/charts.json. Data only: no code files.

nodes.label: verify_report
nodes.summary: Per-region results: overflow, fidelity, visibility, ssim, style; plus the list of failing regions and the components they map to.

nodes.label: regions[].style_deviations[] {property, expected, actual}
nodes.summary: Field regions[].style_deviations[] {property, expected, actual} of verify_report.

nodes.label: failing_regions[] {region_id, component, checks[]}
nodes.summary: Field failing_regions[] {region_id, component, checks[]} of verify_report.

nodes.label: region_crops
nodes.summary: Side-by-side crops (source | render) for each failing region.

nodes.label: repair_log
nodes.summary: What Claude changed in each repair round, which failures it targeted, and the files touched.

nodes.label: stress_cases
nodes.summary: Seeded edge-case documents generated from the data schema.

nodes.label: stress_report
nodes.summary: Per-case overflow, fidelity and visibility results.

nodes.label: review_pages
nodes.summary: Self-contained review pages for each human gate.

nodes.label: release_manifest
nodes.summary: Operating contract of the release: versions it was frozen with (engine, ontology, library), sha256 of every file and source, fonts, schedule, parameter universes, verification/approval/publish policy. Every property names its ontology term in the schema; an undeclared property fails check_manifest.

nodes.label: fonts[] {family, file, license, sha256}
nodes.summary: Field fonts[] {family, file, license, sha256} of release_manifest.

nodes.label: schedule{cadence, run_on, as_of, calendar, timezone}
nodes.summary: Field schedule{cadence, run_on, as_of, calendar, timezone} of release_manifest.

nodes.label: approval{sample_rate, sample_min, full_review_after_release}
nodes.summary: Field approval{sample_rate, sample_min, full_review_after_release} of release_manifest.

nodes.label: publish{path, formats, retention_days}
nodes.summary: Field publish{path, formats, retention_days} of release_manifest.

nodes.label: golden_images
nodes.summary: Golden renders and a mask of static regions (regions with no slots), used by the run phase.

nodes.label: batch_spec
nodes.summary: Run phase input: template_id, template_version, as_of date, documents[{doc_id, fund_id, series, lang}].

nodes.label: batch_data
nodes.summary: One data file per document, loaded from the warehouse.

nodes.label: publish_receipt
nodes.summary: Destination URIs and sha256 for every published document.

nodes.label: semantic_layer
nodes.summary: Meaning (sections, fields, per-locale definitions, rules), provenance (sources, runs, approvals, release) and lineage (field → table.column or computation, universe queries). Skeleton generated at B07, meanings drafted by Claude at B05 and approved at B06, lineage filled by the data team. Compiled to report.graph.json (rpt: ontology) at freeze.

nodes.label: report_graph
nodes.summary: The semantic layer and the manifest compiled against kg/ontology/report.ttl; refused if any emitted predicate is undeclared. Loads into the knowledge graph unchanged.

nodes.label: e03: B01_inspect on pass
nodes.summary: Some pages are pictures: read them with OCR

nodes.label: e04: B01_inspect on pass
nodes.summary: All vector: text already exact, skip OCR

nodes.label: e09: B03_text_review on corrections_submitted
nodes.summary: Data gaps fixed: re-derive sample data

nodes.label: e12: B03_text_review on incomplete
nodes.summary: Items still open: stay with the human

nodes.label: e14: B04_layout on fail
nodes.summary: Layout unreliable: human decides (proceed lets Claude work from the image)

nodes.label: e16: B05_decompose on invalid_output
nodes.summary: Claude could not produce a valid blueprint

nodes.label: e18: B06_blueprint_review on revise
nodes.summary: Claude revises with the reviewer's comments

nodes.label: e21: B06_blueprint_review on invalid_edit
nodes.summary: Human edit broke the schema: back to the human

nodes.label: e24: B07_sample_data on fail
nodes.summary: Schema derivation failed: usually a blueprint problem

nodes.label: e26: B08_generate on invalid_output
nodes.summary: Claude could not produce a compiling project

nodes.label: e30: B10_verify on pass
nodes.summary: Matches the source: now prove it generalizes

nodes.label: e33: B11_repair on pass
nodes.summary: Re-render after every repair (full re-verify, so fixes can't regress other regions)

nodes.label: e35: B12_escalation on retry
nodes.summary: Retry where it failed, with human guidance

nodes.label: e41: B14_stress_verify on fail
nodes.summary: Add fit rules for the failing cases

nodes.label: e48: B16_freeze on fail
nodes.summary: Integrity failure (e.g. files changed after sign-off): re-approve

nodes.label: e52: R01_validate_data on partial
nodes.summary: Valid items continue; invalid wait for R04

nodes.label: e58: R03_verify on pass
nodes.summary: Verified items clean but earlier failures exist

nodes.label: e62: R04_exceptions on exclude
nodes.summary: Drop failed items, continue with the rest

nodes.label: e69: B05_decompose on library_gap
nodes.summary: Component missing from the library: a person adds it through a library release, then retries; proceed = waiver for a one-off
